strings:
Written for Noctiluca's corpus: a chat as frameworks build one. The
     role=log box holds a greeting and the list of messages beside it, not
     the messages themselves; each message has a badge picture, the
     author and the words in several elements. The list is rendered
     again now and then (a new list element with the same messages, as a
     framework recycling its nodes), and the oldest messages are dropped.
     ?quiet stops the timer; window.post(words) adds one message.
